description: Create a home inspection worksheet for a first-time homebuyer documenting issues found during a house walkthrough. Create column headers (Room/Area, Issue Observed, Severity, Est. Min Cost, Est. Max Cost), enter 8 findings with estimated repair costs, create summary formulas to calculate total repair cost range, and determine if costs exceed the $15,000 budget buffer. Save the spreadsheet as home_inspection_walkthrough.xlsx.
